After an initial pending result, GET the exact stable eventId with the same account within a bounded recovery budget. A failed conference does not delete/recreate the successfully created event. Return eventCreated=true and conference.status=failure; a new conference-generation attempt is a new explicit write intent under existing approval, not an automatic retry.
